headline: FBG Duck Murder Jurors Delay Verdict Until Tomorrow After Requesting More Digital Evidence
body: Judge confirms jurors in the FBG Duck murder trial want additional digitized evidence before delivering a verdict. The court announced the delay to tomorrow morning after jurors requested more digital evidence. This development comes as the trial progresses in the high-profile case involving the alleged murder of the 'Duck' figure. The delay has sparked discussion about digital evidence in modern legal proceedings.

caption:
Jurors in the FBG Duck murder trial have requested more digitized evidence before delivering a verdict. The judge confirmed the delay to tomorrow morning. This delay has raised questions about the role of digital evidence in contemporary legal trials. The case has been highly publicized on social media, with the defendant's team reportedly working to secure additional digital evidence for the jury.
